source.title: Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Nominations in Tyrone")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: nominations read on the block images of the Ulster Herald's 'Omagh Boards: Guardians and Rural Council' (26 April 1930, p. 5, article ULH19300426.2.75); contests were threatened only in Crockanboy, Glenlark and Fallagh; one nomination in each other division

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Three contests: Crockanboy, Glenlark and Fallagh. The other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Unopposed returns added from the Ulster Herald's nominations list of 26 April 1930, p. 5 (6 Nov 2026). Mayne is not recorded: the nominee's name is damaged on the page image. Returned unopposed.
